findings.current: A short while later, the child held a piece of candy in each hand, along with a wooden doll about the size of an adult’s palm.
findings.defect: The draft invents two pieces of candy and leaves the child holding three objects. The source only says that candy and a wooden doll were in his hands.
findings.rationale: This preserves the two named items without adding an unsupported quantity.
findings.replacement: A short while later, the child held some candy and a wooden doll about the size of an adult’s palm in his hands.
findings.source: 잠시 후, 울음을 그친 아이의 양손에는 당과와 어른 손바닥만 한 목각 인형이 들려 있었다.

findings.current: “You’re the best, kid! I even bought you a wooden doll!”
findings.defect: The draft makes the father praise his son and say that he bought the doll for him. In context, the father is now cheering Jin Taekyung and announcing that he even bought Taekyung’s wooden likeness.
findings.rationale: The possessive correctly identifies Jin Taekyung as the person being cheered and the figure represented by the doll.
findings.replacement: “You’re the best, kid! I even bought your wooden doll!”

findings.current: No matter how many times I told him not to come, it went in one ear and out the other. Hopeless.
findings.defect: The impersonal idiom weakens Taekyung’s direct, profane irritation. 들어 처먹지를 않다 is a contemptuously vulgar way of saying that Baek Woo refuses to listen.
findings.rationale: The replacement restores the direct subject, present-tense frustration, and strength of the source profanity.
findings.replacement: No matter how many times I tell him not to come, he just won’t fucking listen. He’s hopeless.
findings.source: 오지 말라고 몇 번을 말해도 들어 처먹지를 않으니 답이 없다.

findings.current: “If you’re going to come, at least come normally. Don’t use that Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms or whatever-O Tae-sik thing.”
findings.defect: The hyphenated construction is unnatural English and obscures the deliberate name pun between 팔식 and 오태식.
findings.rationale: This reads naturally while retaining Taekyung’s intentional mangling of the technique’s name into a person’s name.
findings.replacement: “If you’re going to come, at least come normally. Don’t use that Cloud-Dragon Eight Forms or Oh Tae-sik or whatever.”
findings.source: “올 거면 좀 평범하게 와라. 운룡대팔식인지 오태식인지 쓰지 말고.”

findings.current: He must have scampered over to his Master to complain, only to get the exact opposite answer.
findings.defect: The draft softens 일렀다 from tattling and reduces 역관광을 당하다, which means that the attempt backfired on him, to merely receiving an unexpected answer.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves both Baek Woo’s childish tattling and Taekyung’s mocking description of the resulting reversal.
findings.replacement: He must have scampered over to his Master to tattle on me, only to have it blow up in his face.
findings.source: 사부에게 쪼르르 달려가서 일렀다가 역관광을 당한 모양이다.

findings.current: “Sure. But you’ve only mastered fifty percent of it, right?”
findings.defect: 오 성 means the fifth level or degree of mastery, not fifty percent. The draft invents a proportional measurement and changes the martial-art attainment system.
findings.rationale: This preserves the explicitly numbered attainment level without converting it into an unsupported percentage.
findings.replacement: “Sure. But you’ve only mastered it to the fifth level, right?”
findings.source: “그래. 그런데 너는 오 성까지밖에 못 익혔고?”

findings.defect: The draft weakens the causal joke: Taekyung asks whether Gung Gibang brought the washbasin because he has only attained the fifth level.
findings.rationale: The replacement restores the explicit causal link conveyed by 그래서.

findings.defect: Galgyun is an unsupported romanization rather than the established character name or a natural shortening of it.
findings.rationale: Gyun naturally preserves the casual shortened address while remaining consistent with the established name Zhuge Gyun.

findings.current: There were even cases where someone won a duel after a desperate, life-or-death struggle, only to withdraw afterward.
findings.defect: Life-or-death struggle makes the formal nonlethal duels explicitly mortal. 백척간두 here describes an extremely precarious, razor-close contest, not necessarily a fight to the death.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the narrow, exhausting victory without adding lethal stakes absent from the source.
findings.replacement: There were even cases where someone won a razor-close duel, only to withdraw afterward.
findings.source: 그렇다 보니 어느 정도의 부상은 피할 수 없었고, 백척간두의 승부 끝에 비무에서 승리하더라도 기권하는 상황도 생겼다.

findings.defect: Galgyun repeats the unsupported romanization instead of using the established name or its natural casual shortening.
findings.rationale: This keeps Taekyung’s casual manner of reference consistent with the corrected earlier occurrence.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters two quantities or subjects, misstates a martial-art attainment level, weakens several character beats, intensifies a nonlethal duel description, and uses an unsupported nickname romanization.
